body.statement: For the fixed binary graph, \(Cert(A,B)\) decides compatibility and returns the sharp endpoints using a constant number of arithmetic operations and comparisons; for rational inputs it additionally emits the certificates of \(\text{prop:rational-endpoint-certificates}\).
body.justification: The proposition states the operational gain over invoking a generic polynomial optimizer on every input.
body.gap: Existing general algorithms emphasize coverage across graphs; the checked literature does not expose a constant-size certificate for this fixed menu.
body.consumer: Autobounds can use \(Cert\) as a special-case dispatch and as a correctness oracle for its generic optimizer.
